evaluation.human_evals: The developer reports a qualitative evaluation of the model's accuracy in generating factual answers.
evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that the model performs well at producing coherent and contextually relevant text, while noting possible limitations on niche or specialized topics that are underrepresented in training data.

identity.name: GPT-NEO-1.3B-wiki
identity.summary: A fine-tuned version of EleutherAI/gpt-neo-1.3B, trained on the Wikipedia dataset.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned text generation model with reported qualitative evaluation of factual answers but no quantitative accuracy or grounding evaluation; the card itself notes limitations on niche topics, so factually inaccurate outputs are plausible.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned on Wikipedia dataset, and the card itself notes limitations on niche or specialized topics underrepresented in training data, indicating the fine-tuning data is not fully representative of all possible inputs.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card names the Wikipedia dataset but does not document dataset details such as version, preprocessing, or composition, so training/tuning dataset details are insufficiently documented.

possible_risks.description: Without access to the training data, the types of explanations a model can provide are limited and more likely to be incorrect.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not provide access to the fine-tuning dataset or a data sheet, limiting the types of explanations the model can provide about its outputs.

possible_risks.description: The content of the training data used for generating the model's output is not accessible.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not provide access to the training data content, so the content used for generating model outputs is not accessible for attribution.

specifications.model_size: 4.9 GiB of safetensors weights (5,262,346,160 bytes) in F32

training_context.adaptations: The model is based on EleutherAI/gpt-neo-1.3B and was fine-tuned on the Wikipedia dataset. Fine-tuning used mixed precision (float16) on multiple GPUs for three epochs.
